title: H1.25 new-task identity state diagnostic
objective: Test whether the H1.24 task-6262 terminal-transition pattern extends to independent task identities.
scientific_question: Does the H1.24 6262 terminal-transition pattern persist on independent task identities from the same category and adjacent womens-fashion categories?
hypothesis: If 6262 is a broader socks/hosiery state-family signal, new socks/hosiery identities should show more terminal buy transitions than adjacent womens-fashion tasks; if only 6262 repeats, classify the effect as task-identity-specific.
claim_boundary: BASE-30 only; no training, memory, adapter, teacher, retrieval, outcome-conditioned selection, Q3, H2, D0, retention, transfer, or SEED claim.
stop_rules: Stop after exactly 32 preregistered formal attempts.
Do not change task identities, seeds, prompt, parser, horizon, denominator, or category labels after launch.
If all new tasks are zero or invalid, release GPUs and do not start a task-specific rescue sweep.
positive_branch: If new socks/hosiery identities show terminal transitions, classify as category/state-family evidence only and require further independent identities before any efficacy test.
negative_branch: If all new identities remain zero, classify 6262 as task-identity-specific and stop repeated BASE micro-panels.
offline_fallback: only after online initialization/upload failure with exact error and spool hash
next_gate: Run exactly these eight BASE-30 cells after the 8-UUID and storage gate; reconcile by task and category; do not open Q3.
